before: A distributed line that closes its paragraph stretches only its spaces, and a line with nothing to stretch stays at its start edge.
after: With a w:rPrDefault element in the styles part, a left-to-right distributed line that closes its paragraph or a break spreads its slack after every character. Otherwise it stretches its spaces, and a line with nothing to stretch is centered. Tabs and float advances keep their reserved positions.
reason: Only layout geometry changes. Canonical OOXML, source positions, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged. Every peer derives the same geometry from the same styles part.
